name: Infrared Remote & Receiver Kit
description: Like a television remote! Sends pulses of invisible 38kHz infrared light encoded with button commands.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a television remote! Sends pulses of invisible 38kHz infrared light encoded with button commands.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and OUT (Green) to digital pin 11.
commonMistakes: Wiring VCC and GND in reverse (destroys the infrared demodulator chip).
Operating under high-frequency ballast fluorescent lights causing noise spikes.

miniExperiment.title: Remote Control Hex Decoder
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to Pin 11.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Pressing buttons on the handheld remote prints unique hexadecimal codes in Serial Monitor.
